subject.title: fix(clickclack): deliver media and configurable model replies [AI-assisted]

question: Should ClickClack expose a per-account maxTokens contract, and what default behavior should preserve model-mode delivery across supported models?
rationale: The PR’s own live evidence shows the proposed 512 default is unsafe, while choosing 8192 or another value changes cost, latency, and provider behavior; code review cannot select that public policy without owner intent.

options.title: Split the proven media fix
options.body: Land the media/retry work and remove maxTokens from this PR until a separate owner-backed model-budget design is established.

options.title: Define a model-aware contract
options.body: Keep the config only after selecting provider/model-sensitive fallback behavior and adding default and override proof for representative models.

options.title: Accept a fixed channel default
options.body: Choose and document a fixed value with explicit cost and delivery tradeoffs, accepting responsibility for models that consume the budget without visible text.

recommendation.title: Split the proven media fix
recommendation.body: Land the media/retry work and remove maxTokens from this PR until a separate owner-backed model-budget design is established.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available recent ClickClack history signal, though final product authority may require broader repository ownership.
